_readme: RLS suites the rls-live-tests job (scripts/ci/run-rls-suites.mjs) runs but may not pass yet, each for a setup reason. Entries may only be removed: a listed suite that passes fails the job until its entry is deleted. Every suite NOT listed must run all its tests and pass under CI=true.
